Shift Report for 2026-08-06 00:00 to 00:05:

During the reporting period, a single individual was observed approaching and interacting with the main gate at the Chakan Industrial Plant. At 00:01:05, the person was first seen walking towards the main gate from the access road. They reached the main gate at 00:01:40 and were subsequently observed walking along the fence (00:02:15), standing motionless (00:02:50), reaching towards the gate latch (00:03:25), crouching near the gate post (00:04:00), and looking back over their shoulder repeatedly (00:04:35). The individual was last seen walking away from the main gate along the fence line at 00:05:10. The main gate and surrounding area, including a sodium lamp, were also observed at 00:00:30 and again at 00:05:45, with no other notable activity or individuals detected during the shift.
